sentences.zh: 而我们都站在周围，对着这个小家伙满脸笑容。

sentences.en: Overjoyed.
We can't believe our luck.
sentences.zh: 我们简直不敢相信自己的运气。

sentences.zh: 当时我想，啊，不，那只是根管道。

sentences.zh: 我想，管道才不会那样扭动呢。

sentences.zh: 但对这只小动物来说，这绝对是它生命中最糟糕的一晚。

sentences.zh: 阿纳尔比特里斯蒂大几岁。

sentences.en: They met in a karate class.
sentences.zh: 他们在空手道班上认识的。

sentences.en: And like many islanders, he's been rescuing pufflings for as long as he can remember.
sentences.zh: 和许多岛民一样，他从记事起就在救援海雀幼鸟了。

sentences.en: There's one memory that kind of sticks out, so I must have been around eight years old.
sentences.zh: 有一个记忆特别深刻，当时我大概八岁左右。

sentences.en: And we found a puffling that was like way too small.
sentences.zh: 我们发现了一只太小的海雀幼鸟。

sentences.en: So that means that you have to take care of it for like a couple of weeks to let it grow bigger.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你必须照顾它几个星期，让它长大。

sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，我们养了他三个星期。

sentences.zh: 他吃猫粮、鸡肉以及我们给他的各种各样的东西。

sentences.en: And he was super funny as well.

sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，他大到可以放归的那一天终于来了。

sentences.en: So we brought him out to the cliff.
sentences.zh: 于是我们把他带到了悬崖边。

sentences.en: And, you know, I throw him up.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我把他往上抛。

sentences.en: And he looks kind of shaky at firSt.

sentences.zh: 但最终他在飞行中恢复了平衡。

sentences.en: And I'm like, yes, okay, finally he's safe.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，太好了，行了，他终于安全了。

sentences.en: See you in a couple of years.

sentences.zh: 但接着他就开始一头栽下去。

sentences.zh: 他只是想离海洋更近一点。

sentences.en: He eventually basically gets turned around and flies directly into the cliff.
sentences.zh: 最后他基本上调转方向，直接撞到了悬崖上。

sentences.en: And just explodes, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上可以说是粉身碎骨了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was like, no, Kalli!
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，我就想，不，卡利！

sentences.en: And then I started crying.

sentences.zh: 这是一次残酷的教训，让人明白了自然是多么残酷。

sentences.en: And it's just like, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是，你还能怎么办呢？

sentences.en: So here we are at Hamar, or the cliff.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在来到了哈马尔（Hamar），也就是悬崖边。

sentences.zh: 这是人们带它们来这里最常见的地方。

sentences.en: This is an exciting time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个激动人心的时刻。

sentences.zh: 这是你第一次放生海雀幼鸟。

sentences.zh: 但海雀幼鸟就是这样的。

sentences.en: And so that is what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们要做的。

sentences.en: I am afraid something's going to go wrong and he's going to blow back into the cliff and die.
sentences.zh: 我担心会出什么差错，他会被吹回悬崖撞死。

sentences.en: Well, I believe in you.

sentences.zh: 所以你基本上要用双手把他托在怀里。

sentences.zh: 两只手臂就直直地垂在双腿之间。

sentences.en: Isn't he just going to fly back onto the land?
sentences.zh: 它难道不会直接飞回陆地上吗？

sentences.en: It's flapping like a maniac, flapping its absolute brains out.
sentences.zh: 它像疯了似地扇动翅膀，拼尽了全力扑腾。

sentences.zh: 在一段漫长而可怕的时间里，我们看着小鸟向后飘去，一路挣扎着失去高度，直到奇迹般地，这只幼海鹦激发出了一股深层的力量。

sentences.zh: 它不知怎么地在风中占据了极其微弱的一点优势。

sentences.zh: 随后突然冲出海面，飞向开阔地带。

sentences.zh: 刚才这东西还在我的手里。

sentences.zh: 现在我们看到它变成了一个向着地平线前进的小黑点，在远处其中一座岛屿的衬托下形成剪影。

sentences.zh: 当我们终于看不见它时，这只小鸟已经飞到非常、非常、非常遥远的大海上了。

sentences.zh: 当我们开车离开悬崖时，我开心极了。

sentences.zh: 我满脑子都在想，我们救下的那个拼死挣扎的小生命，现在正航行在冰冷的水面上，驶向全新的生活。

sentences.en: A life we can't even imagine.
sentences.zh: 一种我们甚至无法想象的生活。

sentences.en: And we did that.
We fixed that mistake.
We literally saved its life.
sentences.zh: 我们真真切切地救了它一命。

sentences.en: I'm not sure I've saved anything's life before.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定自己以前有没有救过什么生命。

sentences.en: I don't think I've been particularly helpful to anything before.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我以前对任何事都没什么特别大的帮助。

sentences.en: And now I'm like a superhero.
sentences.zh: 而现在我感觉自己就像个超级英雄。

sentences.en: This is all I want to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我唯一想做的事。

sentences.en: One evening, I see the most spectacular sunset of my life.
sentences.zh: 一天傍晚，我看到了我一生中最壮观的日落。

sentences.en: And then I turn around and behind me, at the same time, there is a full rainbow arcing across the sky, ending in a volcano.
sentences.zh: 然后我转过身，与此同时，身后正挂着一道横跨天空的完整彩虹，尽头连接着一座火山。

sentences.zh: 就在当晚，当我们在外面抓鸟时，我们看到了北极光。

sentences.en: It's extremely green.

sentences.zh: 对，而且你能看到淡淡的红色和紫色。

Very bright.

sentences.zh: 接着她给我发了一张照片，里面是她打包好准备寄往女儿大学宿舍的巨大一堆箱子。

sentences.en: Which, totally fair.
sentences.zh: 不过说实话，这也完全合情合理。

sentences.en: But you know what?
I'm also very busy.
I have my own box to worry about.
sentences.zh: 我也有自己的箱子要操心。

sentences.en: And inside it,
I'm going down.

sentences.zh: 一只恰好预约了世界顶级海鹦权威之一的小鸟。

sentences.zh: 休息一会儿，我们马上就去见他。

Right out of the gate,

sentences.en: I'm going to start action here.

sentences.en: Really?

Nothing like a beer in a field.

You think?

sentences.en: Here's one.

Just popped out.
God, they're so funny.

sentences.en: And it's most likely related to they don't have enough power to deal with bad weathers, then they starve and then they die.

kind of sad, actually.

sentences.zh: 他不想扔这只小海鹦，我猜他也不会给它起名字。
